rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, before 2005).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) as 'Forget-Me-Not'.
Introduced in France by Meilland Richardier in 2005.
Introduced in Australia by Corporate Roses Pty. Ltd. in 2011 as 'Forget-Me-Not'.
rows.Bloom: Fuchsia-red, deep pink. Strong, citrus, rose fragrance. 50 to 55 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Glossy, grey-green, maroon highlights foliage.

Height: 31" to 4'11" (80 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5a through 9b. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
